snippet.title: Drunken Goddess Reflux - Demo & Release Date Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Drunken Goddess Reflux: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4150720/Drunken_Goddess_Reflux/

Steam demo out October 19, with the full release planned for December 8!

From the developers of "Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis" comes their latest title! Shot glass Russian roulette against Femme Soule, a demon who loves you enough to kill you. Break the rules as you drink in this twisted game of Russian roulette, and push the demon till she spills it all. Survive the night, and savor seven flavors of ruin!

Drunken Goddess Reflux Store Page:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4150720/Drunken_Goddess_Reflux/

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more at https://iii-initiative.com
